Name: Weird Critters (Content Patcher)
Author: sqbr
Description:
A mod to replace critters with various weird creatures, such as bats, fairies, dragons, and flying eyeballs. Critters are the little animals in the background: birds, rabbits, squirrels, butterflies etc. This mod doesn't affect the parrots, farm animals, monsters, or Rusty the dog.

Not compatible with version 1.4 or below. I am pretty sure it would work in other languages.  

There's toggles to turn on and off weird creatures in the Valley, Desert and Ginger Island. But I didn't change the Ginger Island ones much asides from the butterflies becoming fairies.

Pairs well with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13365/]Weird Recolour[/url],  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12894]Cuter Mines[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12654]Slime Rancher[/url]. You could also add even more critters with any of the Custom Critters add-ons.

[b]Installation Guide:[/b]
Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.
Download the file and unzip.
Put it in the Mods folder.

[b]Customisation:[/b]
Either edit the config.json file or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
ValleyCritters: Turn on or off weird critters in the town/woods etc.
DesertCritters: Turn on or off weird critters in the desert.
IslandCritters: Turn on or off weird critters on Ginger Island.

[b]Credits and Permissions:[/b]
I've used other people's art, as listed in the credits. Asides from the specific licenses associated with those files, people are welcome to modify and re-use this mod as long you give me and the other artists credit.

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
I haven't figured out how to test the bird animations during the Perfection cutscene so if you manage to see them, let me know if they work >.>
Some of the animation is a bit janky.
There's a little green wobbly line that shows up in summer sometimes.

[b]Conflicts:[/b]
This only edits the parts of images to do with critters, so should only conflict with other mods that specifically edit the existing critters.
